title: Safsatalar Ansiklopedisi
author: Immanuel Tolstoyevski
description: “Man is not a rational animal; he is a rationalizing animal.” – Robert Heinlein Will learning about fallacies make you less happy? Should you read this book — or merely pretend you have? If we all understood ad hominem, would our democracies improve? When was the last time an argument truly changed your mind? Encyclopedia of Fallacies explores logic, belief, debate, free will, evolutionary psychology, group dynamics, rhetoric, storytelling, love, lust, and revenge — everything that makes human reasoning both impressive and deeply flawed. We like to think we are rational, yet we are constantly drawn toward slogans, tribal loyalties, comforting certainties, and the illusion of being right.
